title: GDD T-115 — Replay .bcrp: formato binario + test de hash de estado final (Annex D.4)
description: Session replay as the primary field-debugging tool (GDD §13 + Annex D.4). Binary format .bcrp: Header {magic BCRP, formatVersion u16, contentVersion u32, sessionSeed u64, startUtc i64, seatStates u8[4], gameTuningHash u64}; Body {framecount u32, then per-tick PlayerInput deltas RLE-encoded (stick u4 + button u1 per seat, <=3 bytes/tick worst case)}; Footer {finalStateHash u64 (FNV-1a of the serialized Core state at Game Over), crc32}. Recording (sessionSeed + InputSnapshot sequence) and replaying on the same contentVersion reproduces the session bit-for-bit to the same finalStateHash. A contentVersion mismatch at replay reports 'replay incompatible', never a determinism failure. Expected size: 12-min session (~43,200 ticks) < 50 KB. Defines the attach-point for crash telemetry (TASK linked to T-116). Builds on the session-level replay-determinism harness from TASK-028. Read GDD §13 + Annex D.4 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: Writer + reader for the exact D.4 layout (header/body/footer, RLE input deltas, crc32) with format round-trip test
Record -> replay on same contentVersion yields identical finalStateHash across a matrix of test seeds and scripted input sequences (fast-suite test)
contentVersion mismatch at replay surfaces as 'replay incompatible' (typed result), never as a hash/determinism failure; corrupted crc32 detected and reported
Size test: a simulated 12-minute session serializes under 50 KB
finalStateHash is FNV-1a over a canonical Core state serialization defined well enough to be stable across process restarts on the same platform
Tests-first; fast suite green after, no regression

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: De-facto dependency added by review finding: TASK-044 (SeededRandom must be genuine PCG32 per GDD 13 — currently wraps System.Random, whose algorithm is not version-stable, undermining the .bcrp bit-identical replay guarantee this ticket must deliver). Land TASK-044 BEFORE or WITH this ticket; do not build finalStateHash guarantees on System.Random sequences.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Two carry-ins from the TASK-044 PCG32 close (2026-07-07): (1) TASK-044 is now DONE — SeededRandom is genuine PCG32 with canonical stream derivation (sessionSeed -> roundSeed -> named RngStream subsystem streams), removing this ticket's de-facto RNG-stability blocker; replay fidelity per GDD 13 is now achievable. (2) Carry-in nit from rev-c044 (residual LOW): SeededRandom.cs:75's Derive casts ((ulong)(uint)sessionSeed << 32) | (uint)roundNumber are not wrapped in unchecked() — fine under default compiler settings, but the line is a live production path (selector sentinel rounds -1/-2); apply the same one-line unchecked() treatment lines 45/110 already have on this file's next touch. Behavior-preserving, no value-stream shift.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Second carry-in nit for the RNG surface (from rev-c035's TASK-035 close, 2026-07-07): RngStream.cs:16's doc comment for RngStream.Session still says schedule draws belong to the Session stream, but the selector's schedule decisions now live on RngStream.Draws with sentinel rounds -1/-2. Functionally irrelevant; cheapest fix is trimming the Session comment (do NOT move the decisions to Session — that would shift draw outcomes for no benefit). Apply together with the SeededRandom.cs:75 unchecked() nit on this surface's next touch.
